name: Nitrokill
description:
About This Game

Features

  • 12 tracks in 6 different biomes

  • Vehicle customization

  • Blow up your opponents with missiles and a minigun

  • Triggable special events 

  • Intense electronic soundtrack

NOTE ABOUT MULTIPLAYER: Due to unexpected issues with physics replication, multiplayer gameplay has been cancelled. If these issues are fixed at some point, the multiplayer mode will be released as a free update.
short_desc: An action-packed futuristic hovercar racing game in the spirit of legendary Hi-Octane.
